title: Hold an answer back without holding up the connection

cases.says: a request whose STAN is not held is approved at once, and a release with nothing held sends nothing
the answer to a held request reaches the client once the test releases it
holding an answer returns from process at once, so the next request on the same connection is answered while the first waits
release sends the held answers in the order their requests arrived, including two clients with the same STAN
a held answer whose client has gone, before or during the send, is skipped, and the others are still sent and counted
answers held by several sessions while the test releases from its own thread are each sent exactly once
a released answer is not sent again by a later release

origin.section: 16.2 A Listener Runs on the Session's Thread, So a Late Answer Is Scheduled
